title: Execute opcodes and process queues in the VM
lead: Implement every opcode and modifier, per-bot process queues capped at MAXPROCESSES, process death, and in-memory events (cell writes, process spawn and death), with one unit test per opcode and modifier case.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** placement, multi-bot cycle scheduling and the cycle limit (arena slice); serializing events to a file (replay slice).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Milestone 2 and acceptance criterion C15. The architecture sketch has the VM core emit events that the replay and viewers consume.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - VM core package source and unit tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- One test per opcode and modifier, from the ISA spec's worked cases.
- Spawning up to MAXPROCESSES, and the spec's behavior when a spawn would exceed it.
- A process dies on the spec's death conditions; a bot with no processes reports dead.
- Executing an instruction emits exactly the expected events.
- A table-driven test enumerates every opcode, modifier and addressing mode from the spec and fails if any has no case.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Execute one instruction for one process: fetch, evaluate operands, apply, requeue or kill.
- Process queue per bot, front-execute then requeue, per the data model.
- Events are plain values returned to the caller; the core does no I/O (C12).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes, including the enumeration test.
- The purity grep from the previous slice still prints nothing.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-vm-opcodes` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
